{{Quote|And the manufacturer, Sub-Capital Division&mdash;again aha. The subfield says HyperTech Industries. Look that up for me, would you?''"<br />"''An Alliance military contractor based out of Kuat.|Garik Loran and Davian|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
'''HyperTech Industries''' was a manufacturer of [[Hypercomm/Legends|hypercomm]] units that was based out of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]]. In [[43 ABY]], it became involved with the [[Lecersen Conspiracy]]. Its role in the conspiracy was discovered by [[Wraith Squadron]] the following year.<ref name="MK" />
